meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析测序数据,产出质控报告与信号图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做基因组测序研究,需要把比对数据转成可视化结果。
copy.tagline_en: Turn sequencing data into QC charts and genome-wide signal maps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study genomes and need to visualize sequencing data for QC.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能在对话中用 deepTools 处理测序数据：先验证输入文件，再生成工作流脚本，然后执行 BAM 转 bigWig、质控分析和绘制热图/图谱，最后解释结果。
howto.when: 当用户提到 NGS 文件转换（如 BAM 转 bigWig）、测序质控或画热图/图谱等分析需求时触发。

say.text: 把 sample.bam 转成 bigWig 并归一化。
say.note: 将运行 bamCoverage 生成 .bw 文件。

say.text: 对我的 ChIP-seq 样本做质控，画 fingerprint 图。
say.note: 将执行 plotFingerprint 检查富集。

say.text: 画 TSS 附近 ±3kb 的信号热图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use deepTools in conversations to process NGS data: validate input files, generate workflow scripts, perform QC, convert BAM to bigWig, create heatmaps/profiles, and explain the outputs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for NGS file conversion, sequencing QC, or heatmap/profile plots and related analyses.

say_en.text: Convert sample.bam to bigWig and normalize.
say_en.note: Runs bamCoverage and produces a .bw file.

say_en.text: Run QC on my ChIP-seq samples and plot a fingerprint.
Plot a heatmap of signal around TSS ±3kb.
say_en.note: Uses computeMatrix and plotHeatmap to draw the plot.
